quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Jubilant"? (fans erupting in cheers after a last-second win vs. a team quietly packing up after a tough loss)
quests.question: Jubilant
quests.hint: Think about how a crowd reacts the instant the winning goal is scored. What's the opposite of "Jubilant"?
quests.explanation: "Jubilant" means overflowing with joy and celebration. "Despondent" means feeling very low and without hope. Since those are completely different, Despondent is the opposite of Jubilant!
quests.funFact: despondent is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Altruistic"? (volunteering all weekend expecting nothing in return vs. only helping when there's something to gain)
quests.question: Altruistic
quests.hint: Think about the volunteer who shows up every weekend and never asks for any credit. What's the opposite of "Altruistic"?
quests.explanation: "Altruistic" means giving to others without expecting anything back. "Egotistical" means focused mainly on yourself and your own gain. Since those are completely different, Egotistical is the opposite of Altruistic!
quests.funFact: egotistical is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Ostentatious"? (a mansion covered in gold trim and giant statues vs. a small, simple home with no decoration at all)
quests.question: Ostentatious
quests.hint: Think about the house designed to make everyone driving by stop and stare. What's the opposite of "Ostentatious"?
quests.explanation: "Ostentatious" means showy, meant to impress and be noticed. "Humble" means modest and not seeking attention. Since those are completely different, Humble is the opposite of Ostentatious!
quests.funFact: humble is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Truthful"? (a label that lists every real ingredient vs. a trick that makes something look better than it is)
quests.question: Truthful
quests.hint: Think about the label you'd trust to tell you exactly what's really inside. What's the opposite of "Truthful"?
quests.explanation: "Truthful" means honest and accurate. "Deceptive" means designed to mislead someone. Since those are completely different, Deceptive is the opposite of Truthful!
quests.funFact: deceptive is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Sagacious"? (a wise elder giving advice that saves the day vs. a rushed decision that causes a mess)
quests.question: Sagacious
quests.hint: Think about the character in an old fable who always seems to know exactly the right advice to give. What's the opposite of "Sagacious"?
quests.explanation: "Sagacious" means showing very good judgment and wisdom. "Foolish" means lacking good sense or judgment. Since those are completely different, Foolish is the opposite of Sagacious!
quests.funFact: foolish is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Sumptuous"? (a ten-course royal feast on golden plates vs. a single plain bowl of rice)
quests.question: Sumptuous
quests.hint: Think about the meal fit for a king versus a simple meal a monk might eat. What's the opposite of "Sumptuous"?
quests.explanation: "Sumptuous" means luxurious and extremely lavish. "Austere" means plain and without any luxury. Since those are completely different, Austere is the opposite of Sumptuous!
quests.funFact: austere is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Infinite"? (the endless string of counting numbers vs. exactly twelve cookies left in the jar)
quests.question: Infinite
quests.hint: Think about the numbers you could count forever and still never finish. What's the opposite of "Infinite"?
quests.explanation: "Infinite" means without any end, going on forever. "Finite" means having a clear limit or end. Since those are completely different, Finite is the opposite of Infinite!
quests.funFact: finite is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Illustrious"? (a champion celebrated in every history book vs. a forgettable match nobody remembers)
quests.question: Illustrious
quests.hint: Think about the athlete whose name still comes up decades after they retired. What's the opposite of "Illustrious"?
quests.explanation: "Illustrious" means famous and highly respected. "Unremarkable" means not notable or memorable in any way. Since those are completely different, Unremarkable is the opposite of Illustrious!
quests.funFact: unremarkable is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Euphoric"? (jumping and cheering after amazing news vs. quietly gazing out a rainy window)
quests.question: Euphoric
quests.hint: Think about how you'd feel the moment you found out about the best surprise ever. What's the opposite of "Euphoric"?
quests.explanation: "Euphoric" means overwhelmed with intense happiness. "Melancholy" means feeling a gentle, wistful sadness. Since those are completely different, Melancholy is the opposite of Euphoric!
quests.funFact: melancholy is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Voracious"? (a reader finishing five books in a single week vs. a reader who won't even try a new book)
quests.question: Voracious
quests.hint: Think about the reader who begs the librarian for 'just one more' book every single visit. What's the opposite of "Voracious"?
quests.explanation: "Voracious" means having a huge appetite for something, like reading. "Picky" means very selective, refusing most options. Since those are completely different, Picky is the opposite of Voracious!
quests.funFact: picky is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Triumphant"? (a champion raising their arms high after the final whistle vs. a runner-up staring at the ground)
quests.question: Triumphant
quests.hint: Think about the pose an athlete strikes the second they realize they've won. What's the opposite of "Triumphant"?
quests.explanation: "Triumphant" means filled with pride after a big win. "Dejected" means feeling sad and discouraged after a loss. Since those are completely different, Dejected is the opposite of Triumphant!
quests.funFact: dejected is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Unwavering"? (a climber locked onto the summit with total focus vs. someone stopping every few steps unsure whether to continue)
quests.question: Unwavering
quests.hint: Think about the climber who never once considers turning back, even when it's hard. What's the opposite of "Unwavering"?
quests.explanation: "Unwavering" means firm and steady, without doubt. "Wavering" means uncertain and going back and forth. Since those are completely different, Wavering is the opposite of Unwavering!
quests.funFact: wavering is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Prodigious"? (a ten-year-old playing violin like a concert master vs. a skill so small it barely counts)
quests.question: Prodigious
quests.hint: Think about the young musician whose talent leaves the whole audience amazed. What's the opposite of "Prodigious"?
quests.explanation: "Prodigious" means remarkably great or impressive, especially for one's age. "Trivial" means unimportant and small in significance. Since those are completely different, Trivial is the opposite of Prodigious!
quests.funFact: trivial is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Ephemeral"? (a rainbow that fades within minutes vs. a mountain range that has stood for millions of years)
quests.question: Ephemeral
quests.hint: Think about the beautiful thing in the sky you have to look at quickly before it's gone. What's the opposite of "Ephemeral"?
quests.explanation: "Ephemeral" means lasting only a very short time. "Everlasting" means lasting forever, without end. Since those are completely different, Everlasting is the opposite of Ephemeral!
quests.funFact: everlasting is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Astronomical"? (the vast, endless span of the Milky Way vs. a single cell seen only through a microscope)
quests.question: Astronomical
quests.hint: Think about the distance between stars compared to the size of a single grain of pollen. What's the opposite of "Astronomical"?
quests.explanation: "Astronomical" means unimaginably huge, like the size of space. "Microscopic" means so tiny it can only be seen with a microscope. Since those are completely different, Microscopic is the opposite of Astronomical!
quests.funFact: microscopic is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Boundless"? (a night sky that seems to stretch on forever vs. a small fenced-in yard)
quests.question: Boundless
quests.hint: Think about the view of space that keeps going no matter how far a telescope looks. What's the opposite of "Boundless"?
quests.explanation: "Boundless" means having no limits, seemingly endless. "Limited" means restricted, with a clear limit. Since those are completely different, Limited is the opposite of Boundless!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: limited is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Resplendent"? (a sunset blazing in gold and crimson vs. a flat, colorless overcast sky)
quests.question: Resplendent
quests.hint: Think about the sky that makes everyone stop and take a photo, versus one nobody notices. What's the opposite of "Resplendent"?
quests.explanation: "Resplendent" means dazzlingly bright and beautiful. "Drab" means dull and lacking color or brightness. Since those are completely different, Drab is the opposite of Resplendent!
quests.funFact: drab is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Copious"? (a notebook filled front to back with notes vs. a single line jotted on a napkin)
quests.question: Copious
quests.hint: Think about the notebook of a student who writes down every single detail from class. What's the opposite of "Copious"?
quests.explanation: "Copious" means a very large amount of something. "Scant" means a very small, barely sufficient amount. Since those are completely different, Scant is the opposite of Copious!
quests.funFact: scant is an interesting opposite word!

quests.hint: Think about the ocean animal so big that its heart alone weighs as much as a car. What's the opposite of "Gargantuan"?

quests.funFact: diminutive is an interesting opposite word!

quests.funFact: discordant is an interesting opposite word!

quests.explanation: "Industrious" means hardworking and constantly busy. "Idle" means not working, staying inactive. Since those are completely different, Idle is the opposite of Industrious!
quests.funFact: idle is an interesting opposite word!
